name: Adele Cuill
source: Adele is an energetic and entrepreneurial magician. After arriving in Dale penniless, she made her money dancing at a strip club, bought it out, and is now the sole owner of Lady Luck. Adele enjoys authority with her co-workers because she always treats everyone with respect. She likes to dress flashy and takes pride in her gorgeous body.
